description: Source code for a web scraper class 'JulieGoodwin' that extracts recipe information from juliegoodwin.com.au

classes.name: JulieGoodwin
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe details from juliegoodwin.com.au

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the recipe source

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author name of the recipe

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe title

methods.name: extract_time
methods.description: Extracts time (prep or cook) based on keyword from HTML

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Returns the preparation time in minutes

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Returns the cooking time in minutes

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time as sum of prep and cook times

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the number of servings or yields

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the image URL of the recipe

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts and returns list of ingredients
